notes.title: Luma Island Pirates | Patch Notes 1.1.3
notes.content:
Hi Adventurers, 



This update fixes a lot of small but important issues. 🛠️ Achievements should now unlock properly, animals behave as they should, and quests are clearer. We also fixed some graphics problems and made co-op unlocks fairer for everyone. Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback!



The Luma Island Team


[hr][/hr]

PATCH NOTES
Fixed achievements in (hopefully) all save games: Collect'em All, That Took a LOT of Time, Don't Be Koi With Me, Urban Revival & Piracy Pork.

Fixed black streaks on more (unsupported) integrated graphics chips.

Fixed the pirate outfit unlock if you find all 8 crew members and repair the pirate ship without speaking to the pirate captain along the way (i.e. ignoring all quest tasks).

Added new dialogue to the profession quest givers in town, so they can tell you to finish pending quest tasks before you try to deliver the item they asked you to craft.

Fixed an edge case where you couldn't talk to Dr. Archie after collecting all 4 ancient keys.

Fixed the origin tags for the special resources that are needed for building the 5 mega structure shops.

Fixed goats standing still when the fox is nearby.

Fixed farm animals being outside their barns at night.

Fixed farm animals not doing their jobs while you're away from the farm if they got scared by the fox.

Fixed not being able to build near a waterfall by the farm.

Attempted to fix the missing torn pages bug where pages would disappear from the inventory.

Changed player house permit unlocks in Silas' shop, not just the player who picked up the blueprints.

Changed farm animal egg unlocks in the farm shop so that all players can see them, not just the player who built the animal houses.

Changed the unlocks for Luma Eggs in the Pet Shop so 15 of them will unlock when you enter the final chamber in the 'Unravel the mystery of Luma Island' quest (The Pirate Luma Eggs still need to be unlocked by finding them).

Fixed boulders blocking the path in the farm cave in some cases.

Fixed localization issue: Ramón now addresses the player in a gender neutral way in Chinese.

Fixed localization issue: Minor typos for crocus flowers and their descriptions.

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Luma Island Pirates: Quick Patch, Save files & Summer Sale! 🌴
notes.content:
Ahoy, Pirates!

Last Friday, we launched our massive Free Update: Luma Island: Pirates! We're thrilled to see so many of you diving into this new adventure. Since launch, we've been deploying quick patches to smooth out the waters and address your immediate feedback.  A huge thanks for your quick reports – they help a lot! 💛

For a list of fixes, check the Patch Notes at the bottom of this post! 👇


[hr][/hr]Your Original Luma Island Save files are still there!
We've received many questions from early players about save games, and we want to reassure you:

If you played Luma Island before June 20, your original "Vanilla" save files are completely safe and still fully playable.

If you click on the ‘Switch to Vanilla’ button in the lower left corner of the start screen, you can return to your old save games in the “Vanilla” version any time you want.

Luma Island: Pirates is a brand-new, separate adventure with its own progression and save data. Even when you transfer items (Lumas, pets, tools, money, etc.) from your Vanilla save game, your original save file stays exactly the same. Nothing gets wiped, overwritten, or removed.

We've also added in-game messages to explain how saves and transfers work. For more details, check out the full transfer FAQ

[hr][/hr]☀️ Steam Summer Sale – 20% Off! Don't Miss It!
Luma Island: Pirates is 20% off during the Steam Summer Sale! This is the perfect time to return to the island or bring friends with you! Whether you're ready to explore the new content or want to play alongside a friend, now's the perfect time to grab Luma Island Pirates at a fantastic price!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408820/Luma_Island/"][/dynamiclink]
[hr][/hr]🔧Patch Notes
Fixed a bug where the Explorer outfit would not be correctly granted to players who bought Luma Island before the Pirates release date.

Fixed an issue that would cause clients to have a black screen when switching rooms in temples at the same time as other players.

Fixed game modes not adhering to the correct sell price of items.

Fixed a bug where pegs would not drop from chests.

Fixed a bug with outfit unlocks when all 8 pirate crew members are found without speaking to the pirate captain along the way.

Fixed a bug where Seeds and Everseeds transferred from the Vanilla version wouldn't get unlocked in the farm store.

Fixed a bug with the quest task that tells you to find the entrance to the pirate cove so that it can be completed by being close to any of the 4 entrances.

Fixed a memory allocation issue when entering the Pirate zones.

In the upcoming days, we’ll be addressing performance issues, localization issues (Arabic), and polishing the experience even further. Stay tuned!




The Luma Island Team

notes.title: Luma Island: Pirates - Free update OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy, explorers!



The moment you've been waiting for is here! Get ready to explore, because Luma Island has been completely transformed! This is so much more than a free update:  Luma Island: Pirates is an epic new journey, packed with adventure and available FREE for everybody that owns the base game!



Watch the Release Trailer here!
[previewyoutube="-EzSv_QdwAE;full"][/previewyoutube]
New to Luma Island? Keep an eye on Steam later today for a special discount to celebrate the Pirates launch!



Whether you're returning to explore new territories holding untold secrets or stepping foot on Luma Island for the first time, an epic adventure awaits!



Luma Island’s lost Pirate Legacy awaits unveiling, your pirate adventure begins!



Team Luma Island



PS:  to our early players: Your exclusive Luma Island Explorer Outfit is ready for you in-game; perfect for conquering these new pirate adventures! 🎁


[hr][/hr]
RELEASE NOTES 

New Area and Zone  improvements
A whole new pirate themed area to explore, spanning over the entire length of the game.

Added 4 new entrances to be found in existing zones, unlocking further content in the Pirate Cove.

Introduced new haunted ruins to the Forest/Mountain/Jungle.

Shuffled puzzles in the Farm/Forest/Mountain/Jungle.

New flattened farm, replacing the old hilly one, making building and farming much easier.

Two new construction projects in the pirate cove to unlock new outfits.


New Game Modes
Added 3 unique game modes for different player types.

Cozy Mode: A relaxing experience, for islanders who want to enjoy exploring the island without worrying about danger. No enemies in the mines. Enemies outside will not attack you unless provoked. Most enemies and dangers only make you drop items when hit. Temple traps no longer kill you. Prices for upgrading and buying items are decreased. Increased drops.

Adventure Mode: A balanced experience, for explorers who want a moderate challenge in their adventures. Enemies in the mines and outside make you drop some items on hit. Some of the enemies and dangers outside can kill you and some make you restart at a nearby checkpoint.

Hero Mode: An experience for adventurers who are not afraid to face the dangers of the island during their exploration. Enemies in the mines are stronger and will kill you. Loot is lost on death. Loot dropped when hit will disappears after a few seconds. Some resources are harder to obtain, Prices for upgrading and buying items are increased. Crafting times are longer, Archaeology profession is harder (less attempts per temple).


New Minigames
A new minigame requiring players to uncover the buried treasure hidden around the new Zone.

A new minigame requiring players to test their strength against an Arm Wresting Skeleton.

A new minigame requiring players to test their reaction times against sailors singing sea shanties.

A new minigame requiring players to test their accuracy with a axe throwing.

A new dueling minigame requiring players to test their skill with the whip.

A new minigame requiring players to try their luck on a wheel of fortune.


New Quests
New quest tasks that guide players into the new Pirate Cove zone.

A long quest requiring players to find a lost pirate crew throughout the Pirate Cove.

A new Shipwright Profession quest requiring you to help fix a long lost pirate galleon.

A string of new tool quest tasks have been added to help new players keep their tools to a more appropriate level.

The quest to unravel the mystery of Luma Island now includes more quest tasks with waypoint trails to make it easier to complete.

 
New NPCs
Added a new pirate captain NPC with 2 new quests attached.

Added 8 new Pirate Crew NPCs for players to uncover.

Added a new Shipwright NPC to the town to guide new shipwrights through their professions.

Added 2 new enemy types: a Blunderbuss-wielding ranged skeleton able to cause chaos from afar, and a close quarters skeleton able to slice you up!


Housing
Added a new Pirate themed house for players to unlock and build.


New Lumas and Abilities
Added 3 new cuddly Lumas for you to collect.

Added new Luma ability system giving all Lumas 1 of 5 new unique abilities:

Water Lumas: Can sniff out treasure and will dig up critters!

Earth Lumas: Can sniff out treasure and will harvest extra crops!

Nature Lumas: Can sniff out treasure and will pluck flowers, mushrooms and berries!

Rock Lumas: Can sniff out treasure and will reignite torches!

Lost Lumas: Can sniff out treasure and will attack threats!

Added a new way to create your Lumas.


New Clothing
Added new Explorer outfit for players that played Luma Island (Vanilla) before Luma Island: Pirates came out.

Added 3 new Male outfits players can unlock by completing various tasks in Luma Island: Pirates.

Added 3 new Female outfits players can unlock by completing various tasks in Luma Island: Pirates.

Added 6 new Accessories players can unlock by completing various tasks in Luma Island: Pirates.


New Temple in the Pirate Cove
Added the first "Winged Temple" in the Pirate Cove; a giant meta temple comprising 4 separate wings. 

Added a new explosive barrel trap that destroys everything around it when it goes KA-BOOM (including your friends).

Added a new cursed chest that can only be opened once its guardians have been dispatched.

Added a new rolling barrel trap that will smash anything it collides with.

Added 2 new block puzzles to test players' brains.

 
New Shipwright Profession
Added an 8th profession: the Shipwright. Create boat pieces and fix the long lost pirate galleon in the Pirate Cove for a unique reward.

Added a new Shipwright workstation.

Added a new Shipwright quest unique to the profession


New Emotes
Added 3 new account-wide Emotes to discover. Once unlocked, you can use to them brag to your friends (even if using different save games).

 
New Map and Quest Log Improvements
Map system overhauled with new features and better maps.

Full screen map added.

New trail system added allowing trails to guide you to quests, points of interest, NPCs and other players.

New marker system allows you to discover new points of interest around the world and mark them for you and your friends.

New multiplayer markers allowing you to pin your friends' locations and see them on the map.

Quests tracked in the quest log will now show how much progress is made in them.

Old maps were updated with better markers and map layouts.


Balancing
Jungle temples were lasting a little bit too long, so we tuned them back.

We re-thought Mega Structure costs, removed the meteorites and other hard-to-get items, significantly reduced the cost, and gave them bonuses for creating.

We changed the cost of tools to provide a more streamlined upgrade experience. 

We increased the end game item sell values, and rewards for the final quest tasks in each profession were massively increased. 

House costs were significantly reduced and are now found at the start of the zone, allowing better use of the Teleporters inside.


Miscellaneous
Added spooky pirate ship that roams the Pirate Cove at night.

Added mirrors to all buildable houses (Cottage/Villa/Castle/Tavern) allowing players to change clothing etc at any point in the game.

Extra offering crystals can now be used as lights for the Farm. No more clogging up your inventory with old stuff.

All Mega Structures are now usable shops selling different items.

Final Mega Structure can take you to the ???.

Buildable shops on the Farm are now usable, restocking shops. No more running to town for seeds or general goods!

Added new pirate coins that can be used for minigames, items and more.

New payment system for pirate NPCs, allowing players to spend coins on minigames!

New account unlock system for Emotes, Outfits and more. 

Added a new multiplayer chest that provides big rewards if multiple people dig it up! (It will only appear in multiplayer games).

Added 4 new Eternal Structures for the truly mad Luma Island fans.

Added 20 new unlockable vanity items in the Pirate Cove allowing you to turn your farm into your very own Pirate Cove.

New Rabbit and Chicken skins added.

New save game upgrade system added, allowing players to transfer certain things from their old Vanilla saves when starting a new game in Luma Island: Pirates.

Added ability to sit on the deck chairs around the world.

Added tents to camps around the world to allow you to sleep without returning to the farm.

Craft benches in camps found around the island are now ready to use from the start; no more running back and forward to build camps.

Added a Watch Tower blueprint allowing players to get better views of their farms. 

Added ability to change Game Mode whenever you want via the game settings menu.

Added a new bike blueprint allowing players fast travel to the Town early in the game.

Added a new Anvil blueprint allowing players to upgrade tools at their farm.

Added a new trophy for the Shipwright profession.

Seeds can now be planted in an area in front of the player when keeping the A button / the mouse button pressed (the number of tiles scales with the Hoe level).

Magnetic loot will now stack into 1 neat pile when 10 of the same item are close (This prevents giant farms with thousands of magnetic loot from crashing).

Added 6 unlockable bikes around town when fixing the town for Hugo that allow players to fast travel back to the Farm.

Added new Luma Island: Pirates logo, music, and background to the Main Menu.

Added ability to whip friends.

 
Achievements
Added 20 new achievements, removed all difficulty-specific achievements.


Localization
Added 5 new Languages: Polish, Arabic, Dutch, Turkish, Latin-American Spanish.


Performance
Changed our lights and shadowing to our own solution that should give more stable performance when many shadows are active (torches in caves, temples).

Added new culling systems for improved performance.

Added new batching systems for improved performance.

Reduced hiccups when players switch levels in multiplayer.

Added a new pathfinding system allowing for smoother movement and better optimized gameplay. 


Music
Added many new zone tracks. 

Updated old tracks and added new audio to old zones.


Bug fixes
Moved pathfinding and navigable areas to a new system that should be more robust/stable. This should fix a variety of getting stuck issues (e.g. lava platforms, hills on the farm map).

Fixed bug preventing players standing on the moving lava stones in rare circumstances.

Fixed bug preventing players earning achievements when fixing parts of the town.

Fixed bug preventing pigs from producing in rare circumstances.

Fixed bug that caused animals to get stuck in circumstances.

Fixed bug that caused Lumas to ignore Luma Power Food stored in the Feeding Trough.

Added system that prevents magnetic loot from landing on tiles the player cannot access.

Fixed bug preventing a Snail Luma from being hatched if holding a Snail Luma already.

Fertilizer is no longer taken when removing trees in a sprinkler's area of effect.

Extra tablets are no longer awarded to players upon loading a save with more than 10 quest items.

Fixed collision on pet shop after being repaired.

Construction objects can now be removed regardless of their location on the farm.

and many more: For a full, comprehensive breakdown of all bug fixes, please visit our customer portal.

notes.title: Progress Transfer Unlocked | Release Date News
notes.content:
Good News, Islanders! 🌴

After originally announcing that Luma Island: Pirates would require starting from scratch, we're happy to say that (thanks to your feedback and some creative problem-solving) we've found a solution that lets you bring your progress with you!

While Pirates will still begin with a new save to support all the big updates (like the new farm layout, Pirate Cove zone, new profession, and new difficulty options), you'll now have 2 ways to play Pirates: 

✅ Option 1: Choose to bring your progress with you and:

 Most of your inventory items will come with you
 Everything placed on your farm (animals, crops, buildings, etc.) will be safely packed into a special chest on your new farm
 Tool upgrades, blueprints, craft benches, buildings etc. will be refunded as resources and money in the same chest. It's up to you to decide how you want to spend it all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903916/0fdad18cc074133af3605c6bf6156e2da8bb7565.png

🔍 A few things won’t make the journey: Quest progress, story-related items, and progress outside your farm won’t carry over,  but everything important to your farm life will be right there with you. 

We know your farm took time and creativity,  so if you decide to rebuild your farm, you'll have enough resources and money to bring your vision to life again!

🌱Option 2: Start Fresh for a brand-new adventure

Want a totally clean slate? Choose a completely fresh start for the full Luma Island: Pirates experience:

 Discover everything as if for the first time, with no inventory or upgrades carried over
 Build your dream farm from the ground up 
 Perfect for players who love the thrill of a new beginning 

Mark Your Calendars!
We'll be revealing the official release date for our first Major Free Update:  Luma Island: Pirates during Wholesome Direct 2025 on June 7th! Make sure to tune in for the big announcement and a sneak peek at what's coming.

Huge thanks for your patience and support, it truly helped us get here.

The Luma Island Team

Ahoy, Islanders! 

The development of Luma Island: Pirates is in full sail! We've listened carefully to feedback from the community and have implemented many of your wonderful ideas and requests.💡

Though we're still a ways off from launch, we wanted to share some important details about how you'll experience all the exciting new content.

Upcoming Features:
🏝️ A new pirate-themed zone with minigames, temples, and traps                                                          
⚓ A brand-new profession
🏠 New Farm layout and decorating options to build your dream farm
👗 New outfits and accessories. Change outfits whenever you want

🗺️ A full-screen map with markers

✨ And much more - ALL FOR FREE!  🎁



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44903916/c7da3ff1c8177fe40c6b1bbfd39b934b61ff4e31.png

If you’d rather keep your current progress, you can continue playing Luma Island without the new Pirates content—your saves will remain available and intact. You can set sail on the Pirate adventure whenever you're ready.

You can switch between Luma Island: Pirates and Luma Island Vanilla as you like.

We can't wait to share more about the exciting new content we're creating for you. Your support has made Luma Island an incredible success, and we're thrilled to have you along as we bring you this new pirate adventure!  

Thank you for being such a wonderful part of our community! 🌊🏴‍☠️

- The Luma Island Team

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello, Luma Island adventurers! 🌟 

We're thrilled to share Hotfix 1.0.5, featuring stability enhancements and quality-of-life updates designed to make your journey across the island smoother and more enjoyable. Happy exploring!


Major Fixes and Changes

 Fixed various crash issues on AMD graphics cards.
 Fixed missing bridges on the Jungle Island.


Minor Fixes and Changes

 Fixed some cases where townsfolk would say you didn't craft an item, even though you did it.
 Fixed an issue where the game couldn't progress past the loading screen.
 Fixed Fallen Star Energy so it can no longer be thrown.
 Removed unneeded vegetation toggle button in the main menu.
 Added latest translation fixes & changes.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Hotfix 1.0.4 is now live, bringing essential fixes and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience!

Major Fixes and Changes


 Players that have already upgraded tools will no longer be prompted to upgrade them in their existing quest chains.

 Simultaneously contributing to a construction project or a craft bench with another player will now correctly award all players with progress towards profession quests and achievements.

 Fixed an issue where multiple construction drawings would be bought when right clicking them in the shop.

 Fixed an issue where quests may not progress correctly in certain scenarios.


Minor Fixes and Changes



 General performance improvements.

 Reduced the crafting time of brewing recipes.

 Fixed a bug that could cause loot to be thrown to unreachable areas of Temples.

 🐔 Players that had previously experienced the famous "Chicken Cave Bug" will now have those caves clear again.

 Fixed a few occurrences of graphical glitches in the Town.


Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Major Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!🌴✨

Thanks to your feedback on game balance, resource gathering, and core mechanics over the past few days, we’re excited to share some key improvements! This update fine-tunes several gameplay elements to make resource gathering more enjoyable and progression more rewarding, while also addressing bugs you’ve reported.🌴

We know that navigation has been a challenge for some of you, and we’re actively working on ways to make it easier. We appreciate your support as we work to make Luma Island even better!🌴

Design and Balance Updates

Resource Gathering


 Made it easier to smash Boulders, Ore Rocks and Rubble Rocks.
 Made it easier to cut down Trees and Logs.
 Made it easier to clear Cobwebs.
 Made Trees, Logs and Boulders drop more resources.


Spiders/Ghosts


 Spider/Ghost health has been heavily reduced.
 Spider/Ghost attacks no longer kill the player. Resources are dropped instead.
 The spawn rate of spiders/Ghosts in the Mountain and Jungle caves has been changed.
 Spider silk is guaranteed to drop when spiders are killed.


Tool Upgrades


 The first upgrade for each tool is now free.
 Reduced the resource cost of upgrading most tools.


Crafting and Construction


 Reduced the construction cost of multiple craft benches.
 Reduced the Luma Energy requirements for profession recipes.
 Improved crafting speeds for Forest, Mountain, and Jungle recipes.


General


 Running through crops, bushes, ferns, grass, and water will no longer slow the player down as much.
 Added new beginner tasks to profession quests to teach you how to upgrade tools.
 Increased money received for completing profession quests.
 Increased money received when selling profession items.


Bug Fixes

Major Fixes


 Fixed an issue where crashes as a client could result in a Luma being lost.
 Fixed an issue where players would not receive the lighthouse repair achievement.
 Achievements previously not unlocked erroneously will now be granted on save load.
 Addressed a number of performance issues relating to inserting items in multiplayer.


Minor Fixes


 Fixed a bug where the Tree Ground Rune puzzle would not spawn a treasure chest when complete.
 Improved translations.


We hope these changes make your journey on Luma Island smoother and even more enjoyable. 
—jump in and let us know what you think! 🌴✨✨

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Another Hotfix is Live!  

We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and working hard to make your experience on Luma Island even better. Today's update addresses several key issues to ensure smoother multiplayer adventures, fixes achievement tracking, and resolves other challenges you’ve reported.

Here’s what’s new in this hotfix:

Major Fixes and Changes


 Fixed a number of issues that could cause players to fail to connect to a multiplayer game or to disconnect during the game.

 Fixed an issue that could cause players to not receive Steam Achievements correctly.

 Prevented players mistakenly dropping tools while throwing gravel by rapidly switching items. Missing tools will be re-issued to players that have lost them.

 Existing games that did not receive the Jungle Map will now have it granted.


Minor Fixes and Changes



 Fixed a rare issue where caves may contain a large number of chickens.

 Removed blocking doors in one of the Jungle Temples that would prevent some players from completing the room.


Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content:
Hello wonderful Luma Island adventurers!  

We’re absolutely blown away by your enthusiasm and excitement for Luma Island’s launch—thank you for making it such an incredible start!  As we soak in all your fantastic feedback, our top priority is ensuring your experience is as smooth and magical as possible.

To that end, we’ve just rolled out a hotfix to address some key issues and make your island adventures even better! 

Here’s what we’ve fixed and improved:

Major Fixes and Changes


 Fixed a bug where save games could become corrupted and result in empty levels.

 Fixed a bug where multiple players could insert items to a construction project at the same time, causing it to not be completable.

 Combat doors in temples have been disabled, preventing issues where players could not continue due to missing enemies.

 Fixed a bug where the whip would not be given to the game host.

 If write permissions are not available for game settings, a warning is now displayed.

 Fixed an issue where players would timeout too quickly when trying to join an online game, resulting in a disconnect.


Minor Fixes and Changes



 Fixed a bug where clicking  without hovering over any language in the language select would cause an invalid language to be selected.

 Fixed a bug where multiple players selecting a craft recipe at the same time would cause loot to duplicate.

 Fixed a bug where starting a game with old Dutch language selected causes issues.

 The Beehive is now unlocked in the Blueprint shop at the start of the game.

 Cats and dogs will no longer play their hidden chest alert continuously.

 Updated translations where needed

notes.title: 🌟 HUGE NEWS, EVERYONE! 🌟
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

When we started this journey, we were just a small team with big dreams about making an island adventure crafted with love for both experienced gamers and first-time explorers. And now? Luma Island has just crossed 300,000 wishlists! We're absolutely blown away and incredibly grateful for each and every one of you who's joined us on this adventure! 🙏

As a special thank you, we're giving away free game keys on Discord everyday, so join us now and don't miss out on your daily chance to win! 🎮

The demo has received a wave of overwhelmingly positive feedback and your insightful suggestions have truly inspired us! After countless cups of coffee ☕ and passionate team discussions about your feedback, we're thrilled to announce the exciting changes you'll see in the game:


🎮 Gameplay Improvements
 Arachnophobia Button: Hate the spiders in the caves? Toggle this accessibility option in the settings menu to replace all spiders with ghosts.
 Unified Gameplay Mode: Hero and Cozy Modes have been combined into a single, balanced experience: Spiders & ghosts in the caves can now be killed with the whip. You’ll still get kicked out of caves if they kill you but the ‘Lost on death’ mechanic has been removed so you won’t lose anything (apart from time).
 Enhanced Fishing: Clearer visual cues make fishing easier and more intuitive.
 Farm Store: Tired of waiting for more crop seeds to arrive every morning? The Farm Store can now stock more seeds for some crop types.

🗺️ Easier Navigation & New Maps

 New Maps: All main areas in the game now feature new maps in the quest menu.
 Stay Oriented: Never get lost with the new player direction indicator on maps.
 Multiplayer Visibility: Playing with friends? See their locations on the map!
 New Sleep Indicators: Having trouble finding townsfolk at night? Come back in the morning if you spot a ‘Zzz’ marker above their icon.

🎥 More Control Over The Camera

 Camera Zoom: This new slider in the settings menu now lets you adjust the camera zoom—perfect for devices with small screens like the Steam Deck.
 Customizable Sensitivity: Adjust horizontal and vertical camera movement sensitivity independently with separate sliders in the settings menu.

🎨 Personalize Your Character with new customization options

 More face options
 New hairstyles
 A wider range of skin tones

🏘️ A Livelier Town

 More Daily Activities For Townsfolk: Townsfolk now have a wider range of activities (and animations) and sometimes meet up with each other at parties and social events.

🐈‍ More Cat & Dog Breeds

 Expanded Pet Choices: Choose from more cat and dog breeds in the pet shop!

🛠️ Behind-the-Scenes Improvements

 Performance Optimization: Improved performance (including on the Steam Deck).
 Bug Fixes & Stability: Various fixes and optimizations to enhance stability.

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatability
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

For any up and coming adventurers that were hoping to play Luma Island on the go, we have got you covered! We have spent an enormous amount of effort ensuring that everything runs smoothly on the Steam Deck, allowing you to farm, fish and explore on the move.

While the game is completely playable on the Steam Deck right now, we will continuously improve performance to make your adventure on the go a great one!

- The Luma Island Development Team ːsteamhappyː
